Click and drag to see mouse position information sent from outlets one and 3

The lcd object gives you information about the location of your mouse you can use. When you click and drag to draw, the mouse position and an indication that the mouse is down are sent out the first and third outlets. Use the idle message to enable reporting the mouse positions when you are not drawing.
